description:
The service fronts a private ntfy instance at ntfy.unitysvc.dev. Enrolling issues you a unique enrollment code that doubles as your private ntfy topic; the gateway authenticates each publish with your UnitySVC API key and forwards the request body, headers and all, to that topic upstream. ntfy headers pass straight through, so message priorities (1-5), emoji tags, click actions, scheduled delivery, and attachments all work unchanged. Messages are capped at 4096 bytes and retained for 12 hours. Billing is per notification published.

Publish through the single `ntfy-gateway` interface at `${API_GATEWAY_BASE_URL}/ntfy/<your-enrollment-code>`, sending your UnitySVC key as a bearer token — cURL, Python `requests`, or `fetch` all work with no client library. Receive either by subscribing the ntfy mobile app (iOS/Android) directly to server `https://ntfy.unitysvc.dev` with your enrollment code as the topic, or by streaming the gateway's `/json` and `/ws` endpoints with the same key. See the "Getting started" tutorial and user guide for full setup.
name: ntfy-sh
summary: Push notifications over plain HTTP: POST a message from any script, CI pipeline, or app and receive it instantly on your phone, desktop, or a streaming client.

ntfy-upstream.description: Private ntfy instance - no authentication required
